item.title: use the Digital Credentials API to offer credentials
item.description: Starting from Chrome 155, Digital Credentials API issuance is enabled by default. The API makes it easier for websites to provision digital credentials to the user's preferred wallet app. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: a polyfill pilot for WebMCP
item.description: In this blog post, Ian Jacobs, Strategy Team, introduces the second pilot of the W3C Open Source program: a polyfill for the WebMCP API. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Device Posture API
item.description: The Device Posture API allows developers to create user interfaces that adapt to a foldable device's posture and respond to posture changes. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays
item.description: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: DeadTag: Forgotten Third-Party Script Tags Became a Delivery Network for Spyware
item.description: Combined research between Report URI and iVerify has uncovered an extensive ecosystem being used to deliver two of the most capable iOS exploit kits ever seen, Coruna and DarkSword. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.description: What do I need to learn in order to do it? I want it to functionally similarly to this but with a different so I can start my portfolio. All advice is appreciated, thanks in advance. submitted by /u/FakeGrape823 [link] [comments] (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Creating Dynamic Social Media Cards for User Content
item.description: Discover how to create dynamic social media cards for user-generated content and e-commerce sites, enhancing SEO and sharing efficiency. (1 source: frontendfocus)
